description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'IVssDatabase' for a Visual Sensor and Signal Database component. It declares various pure virtual functions for initializing, updating, retrieving metadata and signals, and checking access permissions related to a VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification) database.

classes.name: IVssDatabase
classes.description: An abstract interface class for VSS database operations, including initialization, updating, retrieving metadata and signals, and access permission checks.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the JSON data structure from a file.

methods.name: updateJsonTree
methods.description: Updates the JSON data structure with data from a KuksaChannel and a JSON value.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata for a given VSSPath with a specified JSON value.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with a given VSSPath.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets a signal value at a given path and attribute, returns updated JSON data.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves the signal data at a specified path and attribute, optionally as a string.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given VSSPath exists.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSSPath is writable.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if a given VSSPath is readable.

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if an attribute exists and can be set on a given VSSPath.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Returns the data type of a value at the specified VSSPath.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of leaf paths under a given VSSPath.

methods.name: checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Checks and sanitizes the type of a JSON value and its metadata.
